title: Putin Tells Trump Peace Talks Are Unlikely, Cites Ukrainian Drone Attacks Inside Russia
detail: Russian President Vladimir Putin told former U.S. President Donald Trump that peace talks with Ukraine are unlikely at this time, pointing to ongoing Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian territory as the primary obstacle to negotiations. The statement signals continued Russian intransigence toward a negotiated settlement despite international diplomatic pressure.

media.caption: Putin tells Trump peace talks with Ukraine are unlikely due to drone attacks on Russian territory

title: Russian Glide Bomb Kills at Least 15 in Zaporizhzhia
detail: A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 15 people, according to BBC reporting. The strike is a distinct incident from an earlier Russian attack on a bus in Kramatorsk, marking a particularly deadly day of Russian strikes across eastern and southern Ukraine.

title: Trump Threatens to Cut US Intelligence to Kyiv, Demands Zelensky Be Replaced; UK Backs Zelensky
detail: Former U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to cut off U.S. intelligence sharing with Kyiv in a dispute over Ukraine's oil strikes inside Russia, escalating tensions between Washington and Kyiv. Trump also openly called for Ukrainian President Zelensky to be replaced with a leader willing to end the war. The UK government responded by reaffirming total solidarity with Zelensky, rejecting any outside demand for leadership change in Kyiv.

title: Russian Strikes Kill 11 in Ukraine Amid Trump-Putin Diesel Supply Deal
detail: Russian attacks killed 11 people in Ukraine, drawing renewed condemnation from Kyiv following the announcement of a diesel supply deal between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Ukrainian officials condemned the strikes and the deal as undermining international pressure on Moscow.
